title: ID0457064-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002552] Faulty plug
description:
Reported behavior/issue-Faulty plug
Possible Solution: We need to make an Software Update / update the Charger Firmware in order for the EcoG to work properly

additional_info.subject: Case notes
additional_info.body:
Hi,
The charger n. 170002552 is not working (I did not add the asset, because the portal do not give me the possibility to do it). There is a faulty plug (2) and it seems there is a recharge on the plug n. 1, but we do not think it's real. We performed a reboot, but it did not work.
Can you help us?
Thank you in advance.
software version
: v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0457064-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002552] Faulty plug CRM:03057000041
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0457064.
The ticket was opened for outlet DC1 (ConnectorId: 2) out of order on charger
MP/R9 170002552.
I had the chance to discuss the topic with Giuseppe, who follows in copy, and checked the logs as per reported in the previous emails in this ticket.
I discovered that, on 22.10.2025, I general connectivity issue with OCPP Backend for IPlanet took place, resulting in some chargers (including this one)  being rejected by the Backend, hence in the logs we saw the BootNotifications rejected.
This event resulted also in outlet DC1 (ConnectorId: 2) going out of order. The issue then was addressed by the service colleagues in Italy, and resolved itself.
The outlet DC1 was indicated as OoO for some days on Sifinity, even if it was available and working. This was a bug on Sifinity platform, which will be addressed by IoT team. I always suggest, when required to check the status of an outlet, to check the StatusNotifications and the events in the "Event" section, to have a precise and accurate overview of the status of the charger.
In conclusion, the outlet went OoO as a consequence of a disruption with the Custoemr's Backend.
Since no further action is required from service side, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
